narrative.offerRewardText: Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. You must return this to him as quickly as possible.
narrative.requestItemsText:
So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.

You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, adventurer. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.

But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.
